word_order: SVO — main declarative clauses show subject before the finite verb (V2) as in 'Die Architektur befasst sich...', while subordinate clauses in the samples show verb-final order
punctuation_present: always — as observed in the sample
notes_for_prompt_writer: Prefer splitting at strong punctuation (period, colon) or between completed main clauses; be cautious with commas because they often join lists or introduce subordinate clauses. Avoid finalising translation immediately after complementizers or clause-openers like "dass", "nachdem", "Das bedeutet" — these typically lead into material that changes the reading. Treat abbreviations with internal periods (e.g. "z. B.", "Dr.") and parentheses as non-final.
